name: alm_auto_update
note: rename: cfg_An. @@An 0/1, default 1, EEPROM $1026. 1 = almanac_switch validates and adopts almanacs collected from the satellites (task from alm_word_store); 0 = only an @@Cb almanac (alm_new_ready) is adopted

name: dgps_max_age
note: @@AJ 5-180 s, default 90, EEPROM block $10D0; diff_age_check: corrections stale when age >= this x 10

name: svset_dop_kind
note: rename: cfg_Aj. @@Aj, default internal 2; DOP used to rank SV sets (copied to pred bank +$619, dop_compute $08C7DE). Host 0 GDOP, 1 PDOP, 2 HDOP, 3 VDOP, 4 TDOP -> internal 0, 2, 1, 4, 3 (internal 0 G, 1 H, 2 P, 3 T, 4 V); EEPROM $1027

name: svset_dop_hyst
note: rename: cfg_Ak. @@Ak x 0.1 (< 100.0), default 1.0, EEPROM $1028; svset_select and sv_select_nav switch to a new SV set only if its DOP x 10 + this x 10 < current set's

name: hdop_mask
note: @@AC x 0.1 (1.0-99.9), default 12.0, EEPROM $1030; nav_solve_mode 2D limit; reset value of pos_smooth_dop

name: fix_min_smooth
note: rename: cfg_AD. @@AD byte 0 (< $80), default 0, EEPROM $10CA; sv_select_nav drops a channel from the fix while its smoothing count (chan_decode +$46, s) < this (0 = off)

name: bh_min
note: @@AD byte 1 (< $80), EEPROM $087A, default $20; msg_Bh sends a channel only if chan_meas smooth_count > this

name: nav_all_in_view
note: rename: cfg_Ar_b0. @@Ar bit 0, default 1, EEPROM $10A2; also set to 1 by @@Ce, RTCM (rtcm_apply_corr) and fresh corrections (diff_age_check). 1 = SV sets of 8 (pred +$618), all usable channels in the fix, search by svset_select; 0 = sets of 4, fix limited to the best 4-SV set (sv_select_nav, with >= 5 SVs, navigating, no DGPS), search by sv_search_pass(1)

name: trk_adapt_on
note: rename: cfg_Ar_b6n. @@Ar bit 6 clear -> 1, default 1, EEPROM $1098. 1 = chan_isr state-5 amplitude-spread weighting ($1F4/$204 per channel) and PLL loss limit 90 (chan_pll_check); 0 = fixed $204 = $80, $1F4 = 0, loss limit 6

name: pos_filter_on
note: @@Ar bit 7 clear -> 1, default 1, EEPROM $109B; 0 disables pos_smooth

name: iono_on
note: @@Aq 0/1, default 1, EEPROM $109A; sv_clock_update subtracts Klobuchar delay when 1

name: srch_by_elev
note: rename: cfg_Ah. @@Ah 2 -> 1, default 0, EEPROM $10C9. 1 = sv_search_pass(2): search list = SVs by elevation (pred +4) instead of DOP-set order (+$29); vis_list_default reorders likewise; copied to pred input $CB5

name: aw_gps_time
note: rename: cfg_Aw_9D0F. Complement of utc_mode written by @@Aw (opt I: only bit 0 of 0-7 used); default 0, EEPROM $10E1; read only by reply_Aw and @@Bn/@@En byte 20

name: en_rsvd_9d12
note: rename: cfg_9D12. 3-byte @@Bn/@@En byte 9; set 1 by every accepted @@Bn/@@En and default; no reader

name: en_month
note: @@Bn/@@En output, always 0 (cleared by the input handlers)

name: pos_smooth_dop
note: pos_smooth HDOP working limit: reset to hdop_mask (nav_reset, nav_step), lowered to the current HDOP in mode 2/3

name: cfg_AF
note: @@AF word (< 900), default 7, EEPROM block $115A; no reader besides reply_AF and the EEPROM block

name: cfg_AG
note: @@AG 0/1, default 1; read only by reply_AG and msg_Bm

name: cfg_AH
note: @@AH 0-2, default 0; read only by reply_AH and msg_Bm

name: cfg_AI
note: @@AI word x 0.5 (double), default 3704.0; read only by reply_AI and msg_Bm

name: cm_set
note: set 1 by a valid @@Cm; no reader

name: cl_echo
note: @@Cl echo record $3644-$3687 (h, lat, lon, date, time, offset, mask, $366C value); filled by pos_time_snapshot and the cl_parse_* helpers; read only by reply_Cl (task $8EA $09FAF4 is empty)

name: bm_fields_clear
note: Zeroes $3605-$3618 and @@Cm values $3630-$3642; only caller boot_search_reset

name: bin_hz
note: word, Doppler bin offset x 100 Hz

name: vel_up
note: search_ctl: copy of $8F20-$8F47 (vel up, north, east, heading, speed) when fix_valid (chan_search_center)
